Saptarushi · vendored third-party modules
==========================================

The Panchangam engine and its astronomical core are vendored here (MIT)
so the almanac can be computed fully offline.

panchangam.js  (~399 KB)
  @ishubhamx/panchangam-js v3.0.0  —  Swiss-Ephemeris–precision panchanga
  computation (Lahiri ayanamsa): pancha-angas, muhurtas, choghadiya,
  festivals, dasha, Kundli support.
  Source: npmjs.com/package/@ishubhamx/panchangam-js
  Author: Ishubhamx   License: MIT

panchangam-engine.js  (~107 KB)
  astronomy-engine v2.1.19  (a.k.a. `astronomy-engine` by Don Cross)
  The ephemeris core that computes sunrise, moonrise and planetary
  positions used by the rest of the engine.
  Source: github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy
  Author: Don Cross   License: MIT

Both files were generated by jsDelivr's `+esm` Rollup/esbuild bundle of
their published npm packages. The JSDeLivr-generated bundle header and
the original package READMEs remain intact inside each file.
